description.narrative: Det övergripande målet för CID/BUKA är att tillhandahålla snabb och korrekt rapportering i allmänhetens intresse och med en aktivistisk hållning samt hålla de offentliga tjänstemännen ansvariga. CID/BUKA är ett gott exempel för journalistkåren med målet att tillhandahålla höga etiska standarder i rapporteringen. CID/BUKA samarbetar med likasinnade civilsamhällesorganisationer och rapporterar om åtgärder som vidtagits av medborgaraktivister och därigenom främjar dem. CID/BUKA ökar också medvetenheten om sociala frågor och genom att utöva prövade och lösningsbaserad journalistik.

The overall objective of the CID/BUKA is to provide timely and accurate reporting in the public interest and with an activist stance, as well as to hold public officials accountable. CID/BUKA sets a good example for the journalistic profession with the aim of providing high ethical standards in reporting. CID/BUKA cooperates with like-minded civil society organisations and reports on actions taken by civic activists and thereby promotes them. CID/BUKA also raises awareness of social issues and by practising tried and tested and solution-based journalism

The overall objective of the CID/BUKA is to provide timely and accurate reporting in the public interest and with an activist stance, as well as to hold public officials accountable. CID/BUKA sets a good example for the journalistic profession with the aim of providing high ethical standards in reporting. CID/BUKA cooperates with like-minded civil society organisations and reports on actions taken by civic activists and thereby promotes them. CID/BUKA also raises awareness of social issues and by practising tried and tested and solution-based journalism.
CID/BUKA's strategic objectives are as follows:
-Be placed in the top 3 of most followed and trusted media in the Western Balkans region
-Increase the production of journalistic content
-Increase commercial revenue
-Establish additional newsrooms
